product: Bezuclastinib, an oral selective KIT tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting KIT D816V and exon 17 mutations, developed for GIST in combination with sunitinib and for advanced and non-advanced systemic mastocytosis. Earlier-stage pipeline: CGT4255 mutant ErbB2, CGT1815 pan-KRAS(ON), CGT1145 JAK2 V617F.
demand: Unmet need in imatinib-resistant or intolerant GIST: PEAK showed median PFS of 16.5 versus 9.2 months, hazard ratio 0.50, and 46 versus 26 percent objective response. AdvSM APEX showed 65 percent response and 79 percent 12-month PFS. No revenue is recorded; the company cites physician and patient enthusiasm.
pricing_power: Not found. No product is approved, so there is no net price, gross-to-net or rebate data. The 10-Q lists pricing and reimbursement of product candidates among risks, and payment would depend on US payer coverage decisions after approval.
competition: Blueprint Medicines avapritinib in systemic mastocytosis; Deciphera and ONO ripretinib plus sunitinib in GIST; other KIT and JAK inhibitors in development. Cogent positions bezuclastinib as best-in-class against existing drugs it says have clear limitations and safety concerns.
team: President and Chief Executive Andrew Robbins leads; discovery is in Boulder, Colorado, with roughly 258 employees. In Q2 2026 Cogent said it hired and onboarded its full integrated business team, including clinical account managers, patient access navigators and patient educators, alongside the medical affairs organization.
market_strategy: Launch bezuclastinib itself across three KIT-driven indications using an internal oncology and rare-disease commercial organization, funded by 792.3M dollars of cash at June 30 2026 plus 73.6M dollars of at-the-market proceeds giving runway into late 2028, while advancing the precision pipeline under a 400M dollar ATM shelf.
bull: Two FDA PDUFA dates are near: GIST Nov 30 2026 and NonAdvSM Dec 30 2026, with PEAK PFS 16.5 vs 9.2 months and 46% ORR; Hovione commercial supply signed Sept 1 2026; cash funds into late 2028.
bear: Pre-revenue with no pricing data; single-source Hovione supply; $400M ATM dilution; G&A up 138% YoY; Wall Street Zen cut to Sell Sept 5 2026; 63-day momentum negative; no company disclosure since Sept 15 2026.
falsifier: A complete response letter or delay announced for the Nov 30 2026 GIST PDUFA, or the Dec 30 2026 NonAdvSM PDUFA, would break the bull case.

web_who_loses: Blueprint Medicines avapritinib, the incumbent in advanced and non-advanced systemic mastocytosis that Cogent directly targets with its SUMMIT avapritinib-switch extension; Deciphera and ONO ripretinib plus sunitinib monotherapy in second-line GIST; and generic sunitinib regimens if the combination shifts the treatment paradigm.
